events.headline: IRAN LAUNCHES STRIKES ON GULF, EVEN AS FM VISITS QATAR
events.detail: Iranian FM Araghchi visits Qatar to pay respects following the death of the Father Emir, Sheikh Hamad bin al Thani

events.headline: IRAN WAR LIVE: SIRENS IN BAHRAIN, KUWAIT; US ‘DISABLES’ IRANIAN OIL TANKER
events.detail: Iranian media report explosions on Qeshm Island, Bandar Abbas and Chabahar, as Bahrain and Kuwait sound air raid sirens.

events.headline: EE.UU. INTENSIFICA SU CAMPAÑA AÉREA SOBRE IRÁN Y REACTIVA EL BLOQUEO NAVAL
events.detail: Las fuerzas estadounidenses lanzaron tres oleadas de ataques sobre objetivos iraníes; “más les vale comportarse”, dijo Trump en otra amenaza al régimen

events.headline: UN ANALISTA INTERNACIONAL DETALLÓ LA NUEVA ESTRATEGIA DE EE.UU. PARA ENFRENTAR A
events.detail: La administración de Donald Trump utilizó drones marinos en el estrecho de Ormuz; la tensión escala tras las advertencias del Presidente

events.headline: RUSSIAN ATTACKS KILL 14 AS UKRAINE HITS BLACK SEA OIL TANKERS
events.detail: Civilian casualties are reported in a number of Ukrainian regions, while Kyiv hits 20 Russian vessels in the Black Sea.

events.headline: UKRAINE STRIKES 20 RUSSIAN VESSELS
events.detail: Ukraine released video of strikes on 20 Russian vessels in the Black Sea, including 17 oil tankers.
